Needs changes before merge. The required heavy gate has two failed steps.

This is a safety-tier review. I read the full four-file diff against upstream main `6c164521ff794cbece1f25326c41fd4cc84813ae`.
The local trial merge is `c8f5504fa8326f11267fa57de46b526533b4b0ef`. Its first parent is the PR head.

The bull-nose check uses the cutting atoms and rejects unsupported cuts. The rest warning holds the post.
The three new regression tests pass. I found no blocker in the changed code.

### Local build and tests

All commands ran locally in the foreground. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | PASS: 6 steps, 270 tests, no failures or skips |
| sim library | 241 passed |
| sim `flute_reach` | 3 passed |
| sim `model_excess` | 13 passed |
| sim `turned_hidden_rest` | 6 passed |
| app `turning_hidden_floor` | 7 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim --all-targets -- -D warnings` | PASS |
| `cargo xtask gate light` | PASS: 6 steps, 11 tests |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` | FAIL: 100 steps, 98 accepted, 2 failed, no stalls |

The heavy run includes `app heavy: example_catalog`, which passed.
All four checks for marked known failures failed as expected. The gate accepted those checks.

### Requested before merge

Both failures also occur on unchanged upstream main `6c164521ff794cbece1f25326c41fd4cc84813ae`.
I ran both tests again on that exact commit. These are baseline failures.
The requested all-green rule prevents `merge-ready` while these steps fail.

1. `crates/app/tests/flute_reach.rs:102` — `a_ten_mm_flute_names_its_cause_before_the_rapid_findings` reports 12 rapid warnings. The test expects 3.
2. `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_hsm.rs:79` — `the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean` imports 5,232 triangles on Linux. The test expects 6,228.

The assertion values on the trial merge and the unchanged base are identical:

```text
flute_reach.rs:102
  left: 12
 right: 3

pocket3d_hsm.rs:79
  left: 5232
 right: 6228
```

Resolve both baseline failures before merge. Record the fixed main commit and the green results for both heavy steps.

### Extra suites run

In an isolated `/tmp` copy, `cargo test -p camcraft-sim --test model_excess -- bullnose_envelope` passed all five checks.
This includes the three PR tests and two added review tests:

- `reviewer_unjudged_inputs_hold_the_post`: six cases cover a tilted cut, invalid or empty geometry, missing or invalid tolerance, and a mismatched cutter.
- `reviewer_rest_is_blocking_and_says_bull_nose`: the rest warning blocks posting and gives the expected message.

An independent calculation confirms the R1 gouge of 0.100 mm, ball clearance of 0.192893 mm, and R3 rest of 0.633323 mm.

### Mutations

I ran both mutations in the isolated copy. I did not edit the PR source.

- Restore the ball-only finish verifier: all three PR tests fail as expected.
- Remove the new `RestUnjudged` warning: the rest test fails; the two gouge tests pass.
- Restore the patch: all five review checks pass again.

Goldens moved: none. The PR changes no fixture, importer, UI file, dependency, or process file.
The review worktree and branch remain in place. The worktree is clean and holds the trial merge.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a second read of the same head, at the SAFETY tier: the PR changes a gouge check (law (f), the finish envelope). The first read is the review comment above. This review withdraws the change request of that review on this head. The reason is in "Earlier findings" below.

- Trial merge: PR head `f48a9aaf6c95` + upstream main `39f834bbcd3d` = local `4ad341f2ead9`. The merge is clean. `HEAD^1` is the PR head.
- All builds and tests ran locally on macOS aarch64, in the foreground. No GitHub runner was used.

### Earlier findings (review of this head, base `6c164521ff79`)

1. `flute_reach.rs:102` (heavy, 12 against 3): **no longer applies.** The step is also red on bare upstream main. Under AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review" (#3556), a heavy step is not a merge condition, and a failure that also occurs on main does not block. Issue #3811 tracks it.
2. `pocket3d_hsm.rs:79` (heavy, 5232 against 6228 triangles on Linux): **no longer applies**, for the same reason. It is also red on bare main. Issue #3085 (the bore-count band on platforms that are not pinned) appears to track it. If it does not, the merging session must file an issue for it.

The PR does not cause either failure. Both have the same values on the trial merge and on bare main.

### What the change does

- `finish_envelope` sends an upright, straight bull-nose cut (`0 < corner_r < radius`, no tip angle, no undercut head) in `Mode::Envelope` to a new solid sweep (`bullnose_gouge`). Before, the swept-ball scan judged it. A ball of the same radius stands inside a bull-nose, so the ball scan did not see a corner gouge.
- The sweep uses `Cutter::judged`, so a cutter that does not agree with `ToolGeom` falls back to a flat stack, and the code refuses it (`Err`). It keeps only the atoms below `flute_len`. The shank and holder stay with the band laws, as before.
- It refuses (reports `Gouge` at the move) each case that it cannot judge: an arc, a tilted pose, a non-finite point, no model, an empty model, no tolerance, or a bad tolerance.
- It always adds `RestUnjudged { cells: 0, claims: 0 }`. That warning holds the post (`blocks_post`). The sweep does not measure rest, so it does not say "no rest".
- Reach today: every mill kind in `Mode::Envelope` accepts only `tk::BALL` (`crates/app/src/operation/tool_law.rs:62`). `Cutter::of` sets `corner_r = radius` for a ball nose (`probe.rs:101`), so the new branch does not catch it. The turning kinds have `nose_centers` and skip the branch. Thus no posted program changes today. The branch becomes live when #1531 lets a bull-nose into 3D Finish.

### Results (local)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | PASS, 6 steps: sim lib 241, `flute_reach` 3, `model_excess` 13, `turned_hidden_rest` 6, app `turning_hidden_floor` 7 |
| PR pins (`model_excess -- bullnose`) | PASS, 3 of 3 |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim --all-targets -- -D warnings` | PASS |
| `cargo xtask gate light` | PASS, 6 steps |
| app `posed_contact` (reads `RestUnjudged`, ball path) | PASS, 5 |

### Extra suites run

- app `posed_contact`: 5 passed.
- No `testdata/` file and no importer changed, so the extra kernel STEP suites do not apply.
- Heavy lanes: not run again. The diff does not change a post, a toolpath, an operation or the catalog. The first review ran `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on this head (base `6c164521ff79`, less than 24 h old). `app heavy: example_catalog` passed there. The only two red steps are the baseline failures above.

### Mutations (source edits in the review worktree, restored after each)

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| M1: `corner_r < radius` to `<=` (a ball enters the bull-nose branch) | RED: `..._catches_the_r1_gouge_that_the_ball_misses` (line 79, the explicit and implicit balls do not agree) |
| M2: `allow = tightened(tol) + 0.2` | RED: `..._catches_the_r1_gouge_...` (line 83, the 0.100 mm gouge is missed) |
| M3: the `Err` arm does nothing | GREEN: all 13 `model_excess` tests and 160 sim `verify` lib tests pass. See note 1. |

For M3, I added a temporary local probe test (not pushed). It judges one bull-nose rail six times: upright and clear, tilted, no model, no tolerance, a NaN tolerance, and an empty model. On the PR code, the clear rail gives no gouge and a warning that holds the post. Each of the other five cases gives `Gouge { at: 0 }`. With M3, the probe is red. Thus the refusal arm is correct, but no test in the tree pins it.

### Law check

- Prime Directive: no `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` in the new code. Each input that the sweep cannot judge holds the post. No silent pass.
- Placement: the new test joins the `model_excess` directory suite, in the lowest crate (`camcraft-sim`). It has a provenance line and a Gate map line.
- File size: `finish.rs` is about 200 lines. `types.rs` was over 400 lines before this PR. The PR makes it one line shorter.
- Process: a conventional subject, a `Changelog:` line, and `Refs #1531` (partial work). No process file, dependency, UI file, snapshot, golden or fixture changed.
- Goldens moved: none.

### Requested before merge

None.

### Optional, non-blocking (follow-ups for the merging session to file)

1. P7, a missing test: pin the refusal arm of `bullnose_gouge` (`crates/sim/src/verify/finish.rs:76`). M3 survives every test in the tree. Add a test that holds the post for a tilted pose, an arc, no model and a bad tolerance. The probe above is a model for it. This must be done before #1531 makes the branch reachable from the app.
2. P7, wording: an `Err` result reports `Gouge` ("gouge at move N") for a cut that the sweep could not judge. This agrees with the law (f) precedent, but the message does not tell the user why. A message such as "bull-nose cut not judged (arc or tilted pose)" would say more.
3. P7, a sentinel: `RestUnjudged { cells: 0, claims: 0 }` marks the bull-nose case (`crates/sim/src/verify/types.rs:550`). A ball scan that stops its budget at zero cells would show the bull-nose text. A field or a variant of its own would be clearer.
4. Note: the shorter module comment of `finish.rs` no longer says that the law is "our own measurement". The provenance is still clear from the module text.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
